notes: Added revocation API, audit logging, and test coverage stories to complete lifecycle management.

GPTR-F-002-S63.title: Token Revocation Core Logic
GPTR-F-002-S63.description: Implement explicit token revocation capability that marks tokens as revoked, cascades revocation to rotated descendants if required, and ensures revoked tokens are immediately rejected in all auth flows.
GPTR-F-002-S63.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/auth.py; GAP: No revocation mechanism exists in current bearer token validation

GPTR-F-002-S64.title: Token Management API Endpoints
GPTR-F-002-S64.description: Expose internal API endpoints for token issuance, rotation, and revocation with proper authentication and scope checks. Ensure compatibility with GPTReader and Brain auth flows.
GPTR-F-002-S64.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/gpt_reader.py; Code/Shared/brain_auth.py; GAP: No lifecycle management endpoints currently defined

GPTR-F-002-S65.title: Token Audit Logging and Traceability
GPTR-F-002-S65.description: Extend audit logging to capture token lifecycle events including issuance, rotation, revocation, and expiration with timestamps and actor metadata, aligned with existing GPTReader audit logging patterns.

GPTR-F-002-S66.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Token Lifecycle
GPTR-F-002-S66.description: Develop comprehensive tests covering token issuance, hashing, rotation, expiration, revocation, and rejection scenarios, including edge cases like race conditions and expired-but-cached tokens.
